LightningComponentBundle.description: Full Width - Khoros Community Syndication Blade

property.label: Inverse
property.name: inverse
property.description: Optional inverse property for usage on dark backgrounds (Note: Must match up with a 'dark theme' Khoros Skin ID)

property.label: Skin ID
property.name: skinId
property.description: Provide a custom style/skin id. Use 'IntelCommunityMsgSyndication' for 'Card View' and 'IntelCommunityMSGList' for 'List View'

property.label: Sort By
property.name: sortBy
property.datasource: Most Kudos,Most Comments,Most Views,Created Date (newest to oldest),Created Date (oldest to newest)

property.label: Show Image
property.name: showImage
property.description: If display style is 'List View' this value is ignored.

property.label: Number of Body Lines
property.name: numberOfBodyLines
property.description: If 'Show Message Body' is unchecked this value is ignored.

property.label: Data Config - List Item URL
property.name: listItemUrl
property.description: This is the config endpoint for the data-li-url attribute (Note: this domain must be in the CSP whitelist)

property.label: Data Config - Widget JS Script URL
property.name: khorosScriptSrc
property.description: This is the config endpoint for the widget script src (Note: this domain must be in the CSP whitelist)

property.label: Data Config - Khoros Widget ID
property.name: widgetId
property.description: This is the config id for the widget
